name: last-call-bartending-game
description: Last Call — a stage-based bartending simulation game. Zero-build vanilla JS/HTML/CSS on the web, wrapped with Capacitor for iOS/Android testing builds.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
